concerns.text: T009.1.1 is marked incomplete (`[ ]`) but is required to satisfy FR-001 (download from NCBI GEO/Zenodo). The plan explicitly states 'Real Adapter stub' is for future use, yet FR-001 mandates the system MUST download. Leaving the ingestion logic for real data unimplemented while claiming FR-001 satisfaction is a semantic weakening of the requirement.

T009.2 (LODO Data Prep) is marked incomplete (`[ ]`). FR-010 mandates LODO cross-validation. Without the task to organize datasets into train/test splits for LODO, the validation logic in T030 cannot function, violating the constitutional requirement for cross-stress generalizability validation.

T007.1 (Checksum verification) is marked incomplete (`[ ]`). Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) mandates that 'Every file under data/ is checksummed... and the checksum recorded'. T007 generates data, but T007.1 is the only task to record the hash. Leaving this incomplete violates the Data Hygiene principle.

T024.1 (Metric calculation) is marked incomplete (`[ ]`). FR-011 requires switching metrics from R² to Pearson r based on data mode. T022/T023 depend on this logic to output correct metrics. Without T024.1, the model training tasks cannot fully satisfy FR-011, weakening the functional requirement.

T026 (Consume KEGG mapping) is marked incomplete (`[ ]`) and duplicated. FR-012 mandates mapping metabolite names to KEGG IDs before validation. T033/T034 (Enrichment/Validation) depend on this mapping. Leaving T026 incomplete breaks the chain for FR-008 and SC-004 (Biological validity), violating the requirement.

T041 (Update README) is marked incomplete (`[ ]`). Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) mandates results be reproducible by re-running the project. A README with 'Installation' and 'Execution Command' is essential for this. Leaving it incomplete violates the Reproducibility principle.

T009.3.1 (Validation of distinct stress_vector_seeds) is marked incomplete (`[ ]`). FR-010 (LODO) and Constitution Principle VII (Cross-Stress Generalizability) require independent datasets. T009.3 generates them, but T009.3.1 is the only task to verify their independence. Without this, the LODO validation in T030 is semantically weakened as it cannot guarantee dataset independence.
